chunks.title: ASAL Technologies — AI Software Engineer
chunks.text:
Mohab Haedarea — AI Software Engineer at ASAL Technologies (Palestine, May 2026 – Present).
STATUS: current — this role is ongoing and has not ended.
- Voice AI Agent: Contributed to a modular Arabic (Palestinian/Jordanian dialect) voice AI agent built with Pipecat: engineered conversation state handling, enriched the agent’s context, and improved its behaviour and the overall user experience.
- Latency & Responsiveness: Reduced end-to-end latency across the voice pipeline for smoother, more responsive conversational flow.
- Prompt Optimization Pipeline: Built a DSPy pipeline to migrate prompts from gold-standard models (GPT-4) to Grok, Gemini, and Llama, using Bayesian search (MIPROv2) and genetic mutation (GEPA) to prevent output regressions.
